in_marathi.name: Tirumala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Seven Hills
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tirumala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who resides on the seven hills, Tirumala is a name associated with the Hindu god Lord Venkateswara. It is believed that this name signifies loyalty, peace, and prosperity.
